posts.name: ishitadarade
posts.cooked:
There is a pre existing script.sh file in my BPT3_problem_1,2,3,4 folders and it already contains the solution of the question. When I do synchro eval it is even passing all the public test cases. What is wrong? Kindly help. The deadline is 27 march 11:59 PM so I know the deadline hasn’t passed yet, so what is wrong? Kindly help I need to clarify this to be eligible for the OPPE since avg of first three BPTs should be >40 . So I have to do synchro eval on these script.sh files but it really isnt my fault that they were already there, and this issue is not occurring “since the deadline has passed” because it hasn’t , so these marks should be counted while taking the average of the first three BPTs. Kindly clarify.

Regards

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
If you’re repeating the OPPE then your past term’s solutions will be available under your BPT directories. You can just resubmit them using synchro eval.

If you’re not repeating the OPPE and you never created these files, please let us know.

posts.name: ishitadarade
posts.cooked: Oh okay, this is my repeat term for System commands so yes it makes sense, thank you.
